stem:
Wood pieces that were used to build the frame of a kite are shown.

What are the measures of the missing vertical length, v, and the missing side length, p, in inches?
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Not all answers will be used.
response_template: The measure of the missing vertical length, v, is [blank_1] inches, and the measure of the missing side length, p, is [blank_2] inches.
visual_elements: kite frame diagram with lengths 10 in, 8 in, 15 in, missing v and p labeled
